issues.issue: Automated flag on '2' (Part 2) is a false positive; it is a trial-part label, not an efficacy number.
Flags on '8', '20', '40' are false positives; these are the Week-8 timepoint and the 20/40 mg doses, both excluded/cited.
Flag on '40' is a false positive; it is the 40 mg dose contained in the cited design quote.
Flag on '3' is a false positive; 'Phase 3' is supported by the cited 'second Phase 3 trial' text and the study-design description.
Flags on 28/2018 are dates and are excluded; per rules first_cycle_approval=true is a valid inferential default with no prior CRL in the review.
